song.title: Call It Grace
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C G It's the light that pierces through you to the darkest hidden place .G Em D It knows your deepest secrets but it never looks away . G C G It's the gentle hand that pulls you from the judgement of the crowd . C G Em D When you stand before them guilty and you got no way out
[C1] . Em C G Some may call it foolish and impossible . Em C G But for every heart it rescues, it's a miracle . Em C G D It's nothing less than scandalous this love that took our place . C D G Just call it what it is, call it grace
[V2] .G C G It's the breath that's breathing new life into what we thought was dead .G Em D It's the favor that takes orphans, placing crowns upon their heads .G C G It's the hope for our tomorrows the rock on which we stand . C G Em D It's a strong and mighty fortress even Hell can't stand against
[B1] . Em D G D Amazing, unshaking, This is grace, this is grace . Em D G D Em Unchanging, unfailing, This is grace, this is grace
